integrity: All mathematical hypotheses and the one final scientific claim are explicit in RESULT.md. Reproducible numerical calculations test finite coefficients; an analytical argument proves the asymptotic theorem. Source access limitations are reported. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a two-generation infinite-susceptible-reservoir Poisson branching process with independent generation-dependent offspring; excludes finite-population depletion and later generations. No uniform finite tail crossover threshold is asserted. General compound-Poisson asymptotic priority remains uncertain.
title: A universal early-suppression rare-tail reversal in two-generation Poisson epidemics
